layers.text: Repaint the dark grey-brown stone of the walls, towers and keep as pale warm sandstone, a light cream-beige with slightly darker beige shading, and make the house roofs inside the walls a clear terracotta red. Keep the shapes, the walls, the towers, the keep, the transparent courtyard, the outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the walls.
